class.name: CgameReplayRecorder
class.brief_description: Records and replays server sessions deterministically with per-tick state hashes.
class.description: [CgameReplayRecorder] records the inputs of a session (seeds, initial players and, per tick, the delta and every command) and re-runs them on a fresh server with [method play], returning a state hash per tick. Two runs of the same recording must produce identical hash lists; [method compare] returns the first differing tick, which pinpoints a determinism bug or a tampered recording. Only methods named [code]cmd_*[/code] and [code]submit_input[/code] can be recorded or replayed; everything else ([code]add_player[/code], [code]tick[/code], [code]restore[/code], ...) is refused, so a replay file cannot drive privileged server entry points. Replay files are written with [method FileAccess.store_var] without objects, so loading one can never instantiate scripts. The state hash is 64-bit FNV-1a over canonical JSON ([method hash_variant]). [codeblock] var rec := CgameReplayRecorder.new() rec.seed_value = 42 rec.add_initial_player(1, "Alpha") rec.record_command(1, "submit_input", [1, 1.0, 0.0]) rec.end_tick(0.05) var result := CgameReplayRecorder.play(rec.to_dict(), make_server, hash_state) [/codeblock]

method.name: add_initial_player
method.description: Registers a player that exists before the first tick.

method.name: record_command
method.description: Queues a command for the tick being recorded. Returns [code]false[/code] for methods other than [code]cmd_*[/code] and [code]submit_input[/code].

method.name: end_tick
method.description: Closes the current tick with the delta that is passed to the server's [code]tick()[/code].

method.name: is_allowed_method
method.description: Returns whether a method may be recorded or replayed.

method.name: to_dict
method.description: Returns the recording as a dictionary with [code]format[/code], [code]seed[/code], [code]world_seed[/code], [code]players[/code] and [code]frames[/code].

method.name: save
method.description: Writes the recording to [param path]. Returns [code]false[/code] if the file cannot be opened.

method.name: load
method.description: Reads a recording written by [method save]. Returns an empty dictionary if the file is missing or malformed.

method.name: play
method.description: Re-runs a recording. [param make_server] is called as [code]make_server(seed, world_seed)[/code] and returns the server object, which needs [code]add_player(peer, name)[/code], [code]tick(delta)[/code] and the replayed methods. After each tick the state is hashed with [code]hash_fn(server)[/code]: an [int] result is used as the hash, any other value is hashed with [method hash_variant]. Without [param hash_fn] the result of the server's [code]capture_state()[/code] is hashed. Returns [code]{hashes: Array, rejected: Array[String], ok: bool}[/code]; commands that are not allowed or not implemented by the server are listed in [code]rejected[/code] and skipped.

method.name: fnv1a
method.description: Returns the 64-bit FNV-1a hash of the UTF-8 bytes of [param text].

method.name: hash_variant
method.description: Returns the FNV-1a hash of the canonical (sorted-key) JSON text of [param value].

method.name: compare
method.description: Returns the first tick index at which two hash lists differ (a length mismatch counts), or [code]-1[/code] if they are identical.

members.member: Seed passed to the server factory.
World seed passed to the server factory.
Recorded ticks: [code]{tick, delta, commands}[/code], each command being [code]{peer, method, args}[/code].
